critical_issues: Circular import: constants.py imports from constants, causing ImportError; GRID_SIZE is not defined in this file.
Missing definitions for many constants used by renderer (WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, CELL_SIZE, etc.).
No main game loop or event handling; arrow‑key input is never captured.
game_logic.py contains only placeholder comments and a redundant import; it does not contribute functionality.
main.py defines a duplicate _slide_and_merge_line method outside any class and is never used.
Renderer._font_for_value returns an ellipsis placeholder ("return ...") making rendering incomplete.
The code never instantiates Renderer or Game together, so the application cannot run as provided.
judge.summary: The repository includes a reasonably complete Game class that implements the core 2048 mechanics (grid, sliding, merging, spawning, scoring, and game‑over detection) and a Renderer that can draw the board and display score/highest tile. However, critical infrastructure is missing: constants are undefined, imports are circular, there is no input handling or main loop, and several placeholder stubs prevent execution. Consequently, the solution does not meet the full benchmark requirements and is unlikely to run without substantial additional code.
